notes.title: Buckle up – Creative Mode is here!
notes.notes:
[p]It’s a long-awaited day at Dino HQ, Commuters.
[/p][p]We’re so excited to finally bring you our [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xyZgFdH2gyU"]Creative Mode[/url], inspired by the one you know and love from Mini Metro. Palette-swap your buildings, rotate those pesky driveways, delete buildings, place them wherever your heart desires, and utilise almost unlimited upgrades in a game mode that offers you an all-new way to explore every map you’ve unlocked!
[/p][p]You’ve asked for this one a lot, and we’ve needed to do some tinkering behind the scenes, but it’s finally ready for your magic touch. We can’t wait to see what you build, be it your own hometown, the precise and symmetrical city of your dreams, or a horrifying mess. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for sticking with us for almost six years of Mini Motorways. Disasterpeace has also stuck around, joining us again for this update with an all-new procedurally generated soundscape unique to maps played in Creative Mode.[/p][p][/p][p]Creative Mode gives you the ability to:[/p][list][*][p]Place and edit destinations! Rotate, flip, delete, or adjust colours to your liking.[/p][/*][*][p]Place and edit houses! Change colours or delete houses as you see fit.[/p][/*][*][p]Explore Creative Mode across ALL 23 maps and experience Mini Motorways like never before. [/p][/*][*][p]Creative Mode will be available on every map you have unlocked so far.[/p][/*][*][p]This update also features various improvements and bug fixes, including updated audio in our new Cinematic Mode.[/p][/*][/list][p]We really do want to see your masterpieces, so upload your screenshots to the community hub or tag us on your social platform of choice to share your charming or cursed creations![/p]

notes.title: Coming this August: Creative Mode!
notes.notes:
[p]The cities of the world are your playground with our upcoming Creative Mode, landing on August 26th! Get to know your favourite Mini Motorways maps all over again: swap colours, delete buildings, and design a city where everything is just where you want it. Build with architectural precision or chaotic creative abandon–in Creative Mode, your imagination takes the driver’s seat. 

Did you catch our reveal trailer at the Future Games Show Summer Showcase? Whether you missed it or just want to relive the hype, you can check it out on [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7MKTKRki1Es"]YouTube[/url].

We’re thrilled to deliver this hotly anticipated game mode to our awesome Mini Motorways community. Thank you for your years of support and for allowing us to live our dreams, making games. Sharing this creative joy with our players is a daily reminder of why we love what we do and how lucky we are to have you along for the ride. We hope you enjoy Creative Mode, and we can’t wait for you to show us your creations, whether they’re masterpieces or “masterpieces”![/p]

notes.title: Mini Motorways comes to Denmark!
notes.notes:
Hello, commuters!

Our journey around the world now takes us to a country where our Mini games have never been before: Europe’s green capital, famous for its spire-filled skyline and sustainable design.

This brand-new map is renowned for its colourful architecture, iconic green patina roofs, and green-minded commuters. With Medieval spires adorning the city and plenty of waterways to navigate, Copenhagen is a richly historical destination to hone your city-planning skills. 

You can also capture your European holiday like never before with our recently released Cinematic Mode! This feature immerses you in the city you’ve built, panning across the map and following your individual commuters on their journey. Copenhagen is the perfect city for a good bit of fun, so we’ve tucked away a little easter egg on the map - let us know when you’ve found it!

This update to Mini Motorways includes:
[list]
[*] A brand new map: Copenhagen, Denmark.
[*] The Copenhagen Metro! Train lines are making their way back to Mini Motorways for the first time since the 10-year Miniversary Update
[*] Improvements and additions to our Cinematic Mode, offering deeper immersion and better UI for exploring your bespoke cities. 
[*] A visual easter egg hidden away in the map - best of luck spotting it!
[*] New Achievements, Daily Challenges, Weekly Challenges, and City Challenges.
[*] Various minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

We appreciate Olexa showing off this update for us, you can check his video out here!

[previewyoutube=PpqoPVUIqFU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Our 2025 roadmap has landed - find out what’s in store!
notes.notes:
Since launching Mini Motorways on Steam in 2021, we’ve been so fortunate to have your support and enthusiasm. The last four years have been a blur, but we’ve never run out of ideas for how to make the game even bigger and better, so we’re stoked to share our 2025 roadmap with you all! 

2025 promises to be a big year for Mini Motorways, and we’re kicking things off in the usual fashion with a map update early in the year. However, later on this year, we’re launching a highly-anticipated community feature that’s been cooking for some time. Our team is immensely proud of the work they’ve put in on this one and we think you’re going to love it, too.

Rounding out the year, we wouldn’t be Dinosaur Polo Club without a December update of some kind, and we’re already hard at work on our December map! We’re hoping it comes as a bit of a fun surprise - December is the season for that sort of thing, right?

Thank you again for your support, your time, for helping your fellow players learn the ropes - let’s make this another great year!

notes.notes: A small patch fixing an issue with the colour of the Great Barrier Reef on the Cairns map while using colourblind mode.

notes.title: Come on down under to Cairns, Australia, and get your beach on!
notes.notes:
G’day, city planners! Travel with us to the land down under as we visit the stunning town of Cairns, Australia, in the latest update to Mini Motorways! Known as the gateway to the Great Barrier Reef, Cairns is a nature lover’s paradise fit for the best explorers. Cairns you handle it?!

This tropical haven is situated between lush rainforest and rainbow-hued reefs in Northern Queensland. Create an efficient road network to get Cairn’s citizens from Palm Cove to the Esplanade Lagoon in no time. 

In addition to our first-ever Australian map, this update features:

[list]
[*] Cinematic Mode! This mode pans across the map and follows your commuters on their journey 
[*] Improvement to Game zoom only working when the game window is in focus
[*] New Achievements, Daily Challenges, Weekly Challenges, and City Challenges.
[*] Various minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this bloody good update, and don’t forget to share screenshots and GIFs of your creations! 

We acknowledge and respect the Traditional Custodians of the region, including the Djabugay, Yirrganydji, Buluwai, Gimuy Walubara Yidinji, Mandingalbay Yidinji, Gunggandji, Dulabed and Malanbara Yidinji, Bundabarra and Wadjanbarra Yidinji, Wanyurr Majay, Mamu, and NgadjonJii peoples. The sovereignty of all Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples has never been ceded. We pay our respect to Aboriginal elders past and present as well as their continuing connection to these lands, waters, and communities.

notes.title: Mini Motorways - Patch
notes.notes: This patch contains a fix to version 1.14 which was causing some elements to display incorrectly.

notes.title: Hit the rocky roads with our first Canadian map!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to introduce our first Canadian map to Mini Motorways! Vancouver is a long-requested city, and we know you’re going to love the unique geographical challenges it poses. This coastal city in British Columbia is home to narrow waterways and the famous rugged North Shore, with a bustling metropolis to the south and untamed wilds in every direction.

Vancouver is a city near and dear to our hearts, as some of us have studied, worked, and travelled there in the past, and it’s always fun to work on a map with a bit of dino history.

This update to Mini Motorways includes:
[list]
[*] A brand new map! Take a trip to the west coast of Canada and explore the highly-requested city of Vancouver, our latest Mini Motorways map.
[*] New Achievements, Daily Challenges, Weekly Challenges, and City Challenges.
[*] Various minor bug fixes and performance improvements.
[*] Updated in-game button with a new look and feel. 
[*] There is a known issue in this build: when the 'Analytics Report' option is deselected, the analytics are not disabled until the game is next restarted. Though this has no impact on gameplay, we're still working on a patch to ensure analytics are disabled as soon as that option is chosen.
[/list]

We’re already hard at work on our next update, and it’s going to be a big one! While we tinker away behind the scenes, we hope you enjoy the B.C. coast as much as we have!

notes.title: Mini Motorways - Patch
notes.notes:
This update brings Unity to the latest version.



[b]UPDATE: We've had reports of this build causing crashes on some devices, so we have uploaded the previous version of the game to Steam for those encountering issues. [/b]

We're working on a permanent fix, but in the meantime, if this update has impacted your game's functionality, you can do the following:
- Navigate to Mini Motorways in your Steam library, then right click on it and select Properties. 
- From the Properties menu, open the tab labelled Betas. 
- Enter in the password [b]totallifesaver[/b] and you will gain access to a version of the game labelled [b]previously-live[/b]. 
- This will revert your game to the previous version.

Big thank you to all players who reported this so that we could start work on a fix straight away!

notes.title: Recent macOS 14.2 update causing buttons in Mini Motorways to not be clickable
notes.notes: This patch includes a bug fix for an issue that causes users on macOS 14.2 to lose game functionality in windowed mode. The game will launch in fullscreen mode so that it remains playable as usual. We’re working on a fix to make sure windowed mode is back as soon as possible.

notes.title: Mini Motorways goes north to Iceland in our Aurora Borealis Update!
notes.notes:
Traverse the narrow peninsulas and rugged coves of Reykjavík’s coastline as Mini Motorways arrives in Iceland! This holiday season, cosy up around the fireplace while you tackle the world’s northernmost capital, building a bustling city where the North Atlantic meets the Arctic Ocean. Now it’s your turn to lend your city planner’s touch to this stunning city! 

Enjoy a gorgeous glacial palette in day mode or dive into the fantasy-like colour of the elusive polar lights, famously called the Aurora Borealis! 

This update also includes a few under-the-hood fixes and general polish, as well as the much-requested feature of being able to access the options menu from the pause screen.

Thanks again for celebrating our massive Miniversary birthday with us. We’ve got exciting plans for Mini Motorways in 2024, and we can’t wait to share them with you in the new year!

We want to take a moment to acknowledge what is happening in the town of Grindavik, Iceland. Our team has been keeping up with the news regarding the area’s hundreds of earthquakes and the threat of volcanic eruption – tensions and fears we are familiar with ourselves in seismically active New Zealand. 

Our hearts go out to all those affected. We understand the damage and disruption these events can have on people’s lives, and Iceland is in our thoughts right now. Anyone who knows the process of game development will know that an update such as this one is built long before release day; nevertheless, we’d like to dedicate this update to the Icelandic people. We have long admired your beautiful country, and we hope our latest update can celebrate your renowned capital with the world through the lens of Mini Motorways.

notes.title: Nominate Mini Motorways for the Labour of Love award at this year’s Steam Awards
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35843064/945fcdf52ac61c586fd814842ca873d7af37bd97.png[/img]

Can you believe it’s that time of year already?! The end of the year brings the annual Steam Awards, and we need your help! <3 

If you’ve loved our updates over the last few years, we’d be honoured to have your nomination of Mini Motorways for the Labour of Love award at this year's Steam Awards! Throughout all the years that we’ve been lucky enough to work on Mini Motorways, you all have been keeping us going. From requesting features and beloved cities or hometowns to helping us beta-test new game modes and hunt down those fringe bugs, this community has been an integral part of Mini Motorways’ story. 

We’re honoured to have you all as part of our community, and we can’t wait to show you what we have in store for 2024!

notes.title: Celebrate 10 Years of Mini with the Miniversary Update!
notes.notes:
Happy Birthday, Mini mates!

We’re thrilled to commemorate 10 Years of Mini at Dinosaur Polo Club with a massive Miniversary Update across both Mini Metro and Mini Motorways! 

New to Mini Motorways, we’ve brought over three of your favourite maps from Mini Metro: London, Mumbai, and the winner of our player-voted map competition, New York City! Our three new maps will add an additional piece to the Mini Motorways puzzle as you must plot your roads around their cities’ railway lines.

[list]
[*] From the East River to Central Park. Redesign the roads of New York City’s concrete jungle!
[*] Labelled as India’s own ‘City of Dreams’, how will you control the traffic in the bustling metropolis of Mumbai?
[*] Traverse the River Thames or recreate Trafalgar Square; London’s traffic is now in your hands in this brand-new map! 
[/list]

For the first time in Mini Motorways’ history, The Miniversary Update also introduces a brand-new building type: train stations. With careful planning and attention, you will need to keep up with the demands of these new challenges as you draw your roads around unique existing railroads in these three new maps. This update also features various improvements and bug fixes.

But that’s not all folks; why not cross the tracks to where it all began, as the Miniversary Update also introduces three crossover maps from Mini Motorways to Mini Metro. Now stopping in Tokyo, Lisbon and Warsaw, Mini Metro has never looked this colourful on its 10th Birthday! Capture your stylish Metro networks in-game with our new screenshot frames and GIF capture feature, too. 

It has been an honour and a joy to celebrate the last 10 years of Mini with such an amazing community of players. No matter where you jumped on board, we hope you’ve enjoyed this decade long-journey with us! Who knows where our next destination might take us, but with you there, it’s made the trip well worth it! 

Check out Nookrium previewing the new update here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rjmUwkzFY2E&t

Happy Birthday!

notes.title: Three new maps coming soon to Mini Motorways!
notes.notes:
On July 24th PT, we’re kicking off our Miniversary and celebrating the tenth birthday of Mini Metro with a double update to both Mini Metro and Mini Motorways! Three new fan-favourite cities are yours to manage in Mini Motorways! Wind your roads around Central Park in New York City, take a spin around the iconic roundabouts of London, and connect the variegated neighbourhoods of Mumbai.

In addition to tricky terrain and stylish colours, these maps will add a new layer of strategy to the Mini Motorways experience with a new building type: train stations! How will you navigate your traffic around these existing railroads and keep up with your growing city’s demands? New Daily and Weekly Challenges await, plus fresh achievements and all-new audio landscapes from Disasterpeace!

See you on 24th July PT for the biggest Mini birthday our studio has ever had! 

Check out #miniversary on [url=https://twitter.com/dinopoloclub]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/dinopoloclub]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/dinopoloclub/]Instagram[/url] and give us a follow to stay up to date with all things Mini and more!

notes.title: Minimalist puzzlers Mini Motorways and Mini Metro are getting crossover maps this summer
notes.notes:
Minimalist subway management sim Mini Metro and its overground follow-up Mini Motorways are getting a crossover update on July 24th to celebrate the series’ tenth birthday, developer Dinosaur Polo Club have announced. Maps from Mini Metros are headed to Mini Motorways and vice versa, along with some other additions as part of the nicely named Miniversary Update.

Read more

notes.title: Winning Map Revealed, Plus A Massive Mini Announcement!
notes.notes:
Hello, Mini Mates!

The time has come to reveal the winner of our epic player-voted map competition! You all cast your nominations from a selection of 30 Mini Metro maps and after an astonishing amount of nominations were placed, it all came down to a competitive top four – London, New York City, Paris, and Hong Kong. Thousands of votes were counted and we now have a clear winner of the next map to come to Mini Motorways!

The winner is… 🥁🥁🥁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35843064/1d5c76e8eadf9003afc02d2b5b94bfd3c6fe3bad.png[/img]

This fan-favourite city will see worlds collide as you transition from strategic metro lines to carefully-placed road networks! 

Speaking of worlds colliding…

We’re thrilled to announce a massive[b] Miniversary Update[/b] coming to both Mini Metro and Mini Motorways – featuring the winning map of New York City, and so much more!

This one-of-a-kind crossover update features an assortment of things to explore for players old and new. The Miniversary Update will feature three crossover maps coming to each game (that’s right, that’s a total of SIX new maps!), including, for the first time ever in Mini Motorways, [b]TRAINS[/b]!  Our three newest maps will add an additional piece to the Mini Motorways puzzle as you must plot your roads around their cities’ metro lines.

Make sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/dinopoloclub]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/dinopoloclub/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/dinopoloclub/]Instagram[/url] as we reveal more exciting news about The Miniversary Update, coming to both Mini Metro and Mini Motorways.

notes.title: Introducing the Extra for Experts Update!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to share an exciting bonus update! Introducing the Extra for Experts update, featuring brand new Daily Challenges that offer advanced difficulty for players who want to put their city planning skills to the test. 

This update includes:
[list]
[*] One Daily Challenge per week featuring Expert Mode as a challenge modifier.
[*] Backend controls for the development team to create a smoother player experience for Daily and Weekly Challenges. This should result in much quicker fixes to challenges in the future.
[*] An assortment of bug fixes and performance improvements.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy exploring this update as we eagerly wait to see which Mini Metro map players select to bring over to Mini Motorways in our next update! To place your vote from the top four, head to our website at www.dinopoloclub.com/news/vote – the winner will be revealed May 8th PT, along with other announcements!

notes.title: And then there were four!
notes.notes:
Our team of busy datasaurs has been crunching the numbers all weekend, and the dust has settled. Congratulations to the following four finalist cities!

Introducing London, New York City, Paris and Hong Kong:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35843064/9fcd9e07da687c33f1f22574169aa20cce12d845.png[/img]

Thanks so much to everyone who nominated and shared why your chosen city was special to you. We’ve loved revisiting so many Mini Metro memories over the past few weeks. But only one city can be the winner, and now it’s up to you to make the final call. 

Which city from Mini Metro will be transformed into a challenging new map in Mini Motorways? Head over to our website to [url=https://dinopoloclub.com/2023/04/29/vote/]cast your vote[/url] and we’ll find out the winner together on May 8th PST!

notes.title: Vote Now! Which Mini Metro Map Should Come to Mini Motorways?
notes.notes:
Hello, city planners! 

We are so excited to invite you to take a seat at the developers’ table and give you a peek under the hood – in fact, we’ll hand you some tools so you can help. We’re selecting one map to bring from Mini Metro to Mini Motorways – this is where you come in!

Cast your vote on which Mini Metro map we should bring to Mini Motorways by selecting your top choice from 30 cities! Whether it’s your favourite city to explore or a map that constantly challenges you, we want to know which Mini Metro city you love the most. After the voting closes, we’ll share the top four contenders for a final round of voting.

The winning Mini Metro map will be announced here on May 8th, along with even more exciting news you won’t want to miss! Tune back into this news post as we make more announcements.

notes.notes:
This is a quick patch to address a couple of important issues:
1. We have fixed a bug that was causing crashes on some devices.
2. We have made some visual adjustments to the Busan map.

notes.title: Introducing the latest update to Mini Motorways: Bridge to Busan!
notes.notes:
Greetings, city planners! Come along with us as we tour the newest addition to Mini Motorways: the iconic city of Busan. 

Explore the vibrant port city where the Nakdong River meets the Port of Busan and see if you can keep traffic moving across bridges and the Korean Peninsula’s coastline! With over 3.5 million residents, this bustling metropolis needs your help to ensure its commuters get to where they need to go.

This update also features various performance improvements and bug fixes. We hope you enjoy your next trip around the world!

notes.title: 1.8.3 Patch notes
notes.notes:
We're excited to share that we're working on improving the Daily and Weekly Challenges to create a smoother player experience!

This involves adjusting how we share and change Daily and Weekly Challenges so we can resolve any unplayable challenges much quicker in the future.

This update shouldn't affect the gameplay experience, so please reach out if anything in-game isn't working.

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 30 - 1.8.2 Update Patch
notes.notes:
This update includes some tweaks to accessibility and text visibility, as well as a number of small bug fixes.
[list]
[*] Desktop versions of the game can now use the 'tab' key as a shortcut to toggle between draw mode and delete mode if the "Draw Mode Toggle" option is enabled on the Game Options menu. This shortcut previously existed but was broken for a while and is now back for good!
[*] We've fixed a bug that occurred if the input type was swapped during the transition animation on the weekly upgrade selection screen.
[*] Also fixed an issue where some fonts didn't have both uppercase and lowercase characters. All fonts have both now.

As always, thanks for letting us know if you see the game behaving oddly! We're thrilled with the response to the Endless & Expert Update. 

We've got another update coming soon, this one to Mini Metro, so we'll be seeing you before the year's end!

notes.title: Update Notes for Nov 8 - Endless & Expert Update Patch
notes.notes:
This patch includes some important fixes to address some issues that cropped up in the Endless & Expert Update:
[list]
[*] We've fixed an issue where the new touch screen auto-zoom feature was defaulting to disabled on some devices. This has been adjusted to default to enabled. Unfortunately if you disabled it prior, you'll have to navigate to Options and disable it again. Our apologies!
[*] We have fixed an issue that was preventing players from earning some Daily and Weekly Challenge achievements.
[*] We've fixed a pathfinding issue with the road tile issues in Expert Mode. Some users noticed that cars weren't always taking what appeared to be the shortest path - this is all fixed!
[/list]
Thanks so much to the community members here on Steam and on Reddit who highlighted these issues! We are ever grateful for your vigilance and attention to detail. We hope you're enjoying the new update and please continue to let us know if you see anything unusual!

notes.title: Explore All-New Endless Mode & Expert Mode!
notes.notes:
Greetings, commuters!

You asked, and we listened!  We’re so excited to share that you can now enjoy Mini Motorways at your own speed with two exciting new modes -  Endless Mode and Expert Mode. Whether you want to take the pressure off in Endless Mode and explore each city at your leisure, or go for a joyride in Expert Mode and kick it up a notch, Mini Motorways’ biggest update so far brings something for everyone. 

Endless Mode introduces a brand new way of playing Mini Motorways! Start a new game in Classic Mode, and after you reach the Game Over screen, you can continue in Endless Mode to continue your excellent urban planning and explore the city that could have been! Alternatively, if you’re after a relaxing gameplay session, you can explore Mini Motorways the zen-way by playing Endless Mode right from the start.

Expert Mode comes with a new set of challenges and obstacles, such as permanent roads and limited upgrades. The choice is yours: you can pick from any upgrade, but only for the first eight weeks - after that, it’s just road tiles! This mode is perfect for players who want to switch up their strategy and kick it up a notch.

Unlock Expert Mode for each map by playing some of the unique city challenges available while you explore the 15 iconic destinations available, from Tokyo to Lisbon and many more. In addition to these exciting new game modes, this update brings tweaks to photo mode, all-new Endless Mode and Expert Mode achievements, and a new Expert Mode leaderboard so you can see how you stack up against other Mini Motorways enthusiasts! We've also added the ability to manually zoom in on your city as well as several different zoom levels, so you can choose how you'd like to play.

We hope you enjoy exploring these two new game modes and can’t wait to see how you tackle them your way!

We want to take a moment to thank our amazing community for their support for Endless and Expert Mode! We know it’s been a highly-requested feature for a long time and we’re so thrilled to be able to share this with you all. Mini Motorways was always going to be special to us as our sophomore release, but the passion and creativity of our wonderful community helps make it even more so. Your support and enthusiasm are everything to us and we hope you enjoy the Endless & Expert update.

This update includes:
• Endless Mode - a brand new way of playing Mini Motorways, allowing you to enjoy the game without the threat of a city ending before you want it to, or for those wishing to keep playing after Game Over, you can continue your city in Endless Mode and explore the city that could have been.
• Expert Mode - Unlock a new set of challenges and obstacles, such as permanent roads and limited upgrades, perfect for players who want to switch up their strategy and kick it up a notch. This new game mode also comes with its own leaderboard so you can see how you measure up against the game’s most skilled city planners.
• New Endless Mode and Expert Mode achievements.
• We've also added the ability to manually zoom in to your city as well as several different zoom levels, so you can choose how you'd like to play. These features were much-requested by our community, so thank you for your feedback!
• A new button has been added to the weekly upgrade screen which allows you to view your city before selecting your upgrade.
• New visual indicators for in-game error messages to reduce the number of pop-up boxes on screen.
• Various bug fixes and performance improvements.

Check out Aliensrock exploring Expert Mode now!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7MozdUxTRxQ


And Katherine took an early spin on Endless Mode to show it off here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=00jdRv7r7nc

notes.title: One week until Endless and Expert Mode Arrive!
notes.notes:
Hello, city planners!

We are so thrilled to finally announce that our upcoming Endless & Expert Update, featuring two highly-requested game modes, will be available from November 3rd PST.

Endless Mode offers you a chance to transform our 15 iconic cities into a canvas of artistic roadwork and traffic efficiency, all without the threat of a Game Over. Kick back and watch your map expand as you design the city of your dreams, ideal for those who want to play Mini Motorways the zen way. Earn upgrades along the way by achieving milestones and building an efficient city, but say goodbye to the score and the leaderboard – this mode is all about removing the pressure!

Expert Mode introduces new challenges and obstacles that resemble real-life city planning challenges, such as permanent upgrade and road tile placement. Early-game strategy becomes all the more important here because there’s no going back! Vie for a chance to beat the best of the best by placing on the new Expert Mode leaderboards. Before you can compete against the highest tier of civil engineers, you'll need to reach a certain score on any of the maps' challenges in order to unlock Expert Mode.

The fun doesn’t stop there, though! This update will feature various quality-of-life improvements requested by our awesome community. Discover a new multi-level manual zoom option to choose your preferred way to draw roads in your city on every platform, and make well-informed decisions with the ability to view your current city layout before choosing an upgrade at the end of each week. These last two are features we've sourced directly from community feedback - thanks to everyone over the last year who's taken the time to share your thoughts.

We’re so lucky to have such an inspiring community that supports our games and helps us to continually make Mini Motorways better and better! We know these game modes have been highly desired in the community for a long time and we’re so happy to be able to turn that vision into reality.

notes.title: Mini Motorways' Challenge City update adds fun twists on its urban highway planning
notes.notes:
If you're a motorist in south west England, chances are you've probably encountered (or at least heard of) Swindon's Magic Roundabout. It's a monstrous concoction of five roundabouts smoshed together, and as far as I can see it serves no purpose other than to terrify bamboozled drivers up and down the country. I'm not kidding. In 2009 it was named the fourth scariest junction in Britain, after London's equally mega roundabout at Marble Arch, the M8 junctions in central Glasgow and Birmingham's Gravelly Hill, affectionately known as Spaghetti Junction.

It's the kind of nightmarish urban planning I try to avoid when building my own road networks in Mini Motorways, the excellent sequel to minimalist transport sim Mini Metro, but its new Challenge City update puts all four of these real-world asphalt atrocities to shame. In this new mode, each city gets a bunch of new rules and conditions you'll need to abide by, and after playing an early version of it this week, there's one challenge that's truly diabolical. Not only does it limit the number of road tiles at your disposal, but it does so in favour of, wait for it, unlimited roundabouts.

Read more

notes.title: Mini Motorways review: a sublime and brilliant time-waster
notes.notes:
Does a perfect video game actually exist? I think there’s a strong argument for the idea that a truly perfect game - or any piece of art, for that matter - can never really happen. There’s too many factors at play. With that said, every now and then a game pops up that I truly cannot lay any significant fault at - and one such release is Dinosaur Polo Club’s Mini Motorways.

Originally released via Apple Arcade and now available on PC, the concept of the game is blissfully, eighties-design era simple. You create a city, but this isn’t a typical city builder: all you have to do is craft the road system. Buildings large and small crop up as time progresses, and your job is simply to connect everything up in a sensible manner that encourages further growth.

You have a limited amount of roads and accessories such as roundabouts, traffic lights, bridges, and of course motorways at any given time. Your job is to carefully juggle the needs of the city with the resources you have, producing a layout that minimizes traffic jams. Buildings are color coded - so blue homes will spit out cars of the same color that need to make their way to blue businesses - and therefore quickly the game’s randomly spawning infrastructure will force you to make hard decisions about moving around resources to keep the city moving. If things get too clogged up, it’s game over.

Read more

[list]
[*] We have fixed the issue where the game would get stuck on the initial loading screen and nothing was visible but the spinning loading icon.
[*] We have fixed the situation where some players were only seeing a black screen, but could still hear and interact with the game. We have added in OpenGL support for when players don’t support DirectX 11 or Metal.
[*] Similar to above, players who are experiencing crashes when they play can now set the launch options to [i]-force-glcore[/i] to force the game to start up in OpenGL.
[*] We have fixed the bug with achievements which prevented them from occasionally unlocking. Any achievements you’ve unlocked will be retroactively awarded on Steam when you launch the game.
[*] Fixed a car stalling bug that could happen when a car tried to do a u-turn on a mothballed lane.
[*] We’ve stretched out the End of Week upgrade screen transition animation to help minimise chance for players to accidentally select an upgrade before you can read the options.
[/list]

[b]Design updates/fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] We have added a popup on the Map Select screen for when you try to play a game while you’ve already got a saved game in progress. This should reduce the number of instances where players accidentally overwrite an in-progress game.
[*] Three-way intersections now count properly as intersections and cars will slow down accordingly when passing through them. The fact that they did not before was a bug rather than an intentional design choice.
[*] Increased base intersection speed slightly - this is to help counterbalance the change to three-way intersections.
[*] Tweaks to how often certain upgrades are offered.
[*] Rebalanced traffic lights to change faster / more frequently so as to be more effective. Cars that observe the American red light right hand turn rules no longer effect traffic light change decisions.
[*] Balance passes on both Manila and Rio to continue to spawn destinations late-game and avoid a plateau which can lead to infinitely looping games - there was a bug in spawn behaviour that was causing spawns to appear less frequently than on other maps.
[/list]

notes.title: So what’s next for Mini Motorways?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! It’s been a busy last few weeks at Dino HQ after our Steam launch. We dove straight into fixing bugs and providing some quality-of-life improvements, but we wanted to pause for a moment and say something to everyone reading this: thank you. We are completely overwhelmed by the response the Steam community has shown Mini Motorways. We are proud of our game and the work our team has done on it, but nobody ever expects a launch like this! We are so grateful for your support in all the forms it has taken, everything from wishlisting to checking us out at PAX to sharing the game with your friends.

As we begin production work on our next update, we wanted to let you all know what you can expect from the coming months and years of Mini Motorways. We’ve received a lot of questions about what comes next and when it’s coming and we hope this post can quickly address some of those!

[h2]What is your planned update schedule for Mini Motorways going forward?[/h2]
Since it was first launched on Apple Arcade, we have updated Mini Motorways multiple times a year and we intend to keep up this update frequency in the future. We’ve been updating Mini Metro frequently with new game modes, maps, and features like Steam Workshop support consistently since 2015 (and in fact Mini Metro will have a new update in the next month!) and we intend to support Mini Motorways to the same degree. Different updates may take different lengths of time depending on content and complexity, but they will be coming.

[h2]Will Mini Motorways eventually have all the game modes from Mini Metro?[/h2]
Our eventual vision for Mini Motorways includes a selection of game modes like Mini Metro currently offers. They may not be exact replicas of those same game modes in Mini Metro due to differences between the games under the hood, but we want to add game modes that allow players to relax and explore their creativity as well as modes for more challenge-oriented players.

[h2]Will new cities be added to Mini Motorways?[/h2]
Definitely! We will continue adding new cities based on both our own research and player suggestion, as we’ve done with Mini Metro before. Back when Mini Metro first launched, it had only twelve maps, and over the years it’s grown to almost thirty. We love to get suggestions for new cities - feel free to email them to support@dinopoloclub.com.

[h2]Will you still be patching the game between updates if I find a bug? What’s the best way to report bugs?[/h2]
Now that the dust has settled on our busy post-launch period, we’ll be getting straight to work on the first of our content updates - we’ll still be patching bugs as they occur, but we’ll be balancing our time between support and new updates.  When we’re in production mode, we may not have time to monitor the forums here as closely as we have been but we will still be reviewing posts periodically. If you encounter an urgent issue, please use the support email as those don’t get lost in the scroll! Again, that’s support@dinopoloclub.com.


We are so, so excited about what the future has in store for Mini Motorways. Thank you to everyone who has enjoyed the game and given feedback already - we think you’re going to love what we’ve got coming down the road in the future. :)

notes.title: Mini Motorways is now available on Steam!
notes.notes:
We hope you're ready to hit the road! We are overwhelmed with gratitude at all the excitement, and so we don't get too embarrassing with our speeches, we'll keep it short and sweet: MINI MOTORWAYS IS NOW AVAILABLE ON STEAM! 

We've got some stickied posts over in our discussions area for commonly asked questions and for you to show off your cities. We can't wait to see what you build!

[previewyoutube=RljxPw8zZjs;full][/previewyoutube]

Inspired by real-world engineering?
Fancy yourself a bit of a traffic fixer?
Just here for Disasterpeace's gorgeous ambient soundtrack?

We're glad to have you however you found yourselves here!

[previewyoutube=NvOX8kN2fo4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Update on bugs in older versions of macOS[/b]
We have pushed a patch live as of now that fixes this issue as well as a few smaller bugs! Keep on firing through reports over in the discussions area and we'll keep working on them all launch week. Thanks so much for your help in reporting these and for sending in your logs!

[b]A final note...[/b]
We are beyond stoked with how our first day has gone. We'll be checking in later to let you know what type of support you can expect in the coming weeks and months - updates, planned features, and more!

Enjoy Mini Motorways everyone! We'll be running events and showcasing player creations all week, so post your creations in our stickied thread or tag us on social media with #MiniMotorways and we'd love to show off some of your work!

Have a wonderful day stuck in traffic. :)

notes.title: Mini Motorways hits the road at 8:00am Pacific time! See you in 7 hours!
notes.notes:
It's hard to believe that the day is almost here. The day is winding down here in New Zealand, and by the time we wake up, Mini Motorways will be live on Steam! (Bold of us to assume we'll sleep.) We've been overwhelmed by the love and support from the Steam community - thanks so much to everyone who has watched our dev streams, chilled with us at PAX, and streamed the game in our prelaunch sneak peeks! 

We'll be launching at 8:00am Pacific Time, and if you can't wait that long to get a peek, we've got some amazing videos from our community that you can explore in the meantime. :)

[previewyoutube=igW_n7GGhWY;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll be opening a special launch party Discord server tomorrow, too! We'll be sharing community creations, running giveaways, popping in with streams and an in-office camera feed, and more. We'll pop the link live in a Steam event once we're up and running in our office in New Zealand (again, presuming we sleep). 

We'll leave you until the morning with a video from one of the first people to ever discover and stream Mini Metro back in the day. It's been such a joy to reconnect with so many of you that took a chance on our little game at PAX, IndieCade, GDC, and on streaming over the last several years. We will never forget the people who helped make Mini Metro and now Mini Motorways into the games they are today and we are beyond thrilled to share this next chapter of our studio's adventure with you!

[previewyoutube=BWiDGnSRVnU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Mini Motorways review: life in the fast lane
notes.notes:
If the brilliant Mini Metro gave me a newfound admiration for city subway designers, then Dinosaur Polo Club's latest minimalist transport sim Mini Motorways proves that urban road planners are actual god tier human beings.

Even with some of today's most iconic conurbations such as LA, Tokyo and Dubai reduced to their neatest, simplest geographical lines and land masses, I still manage to make a pig's ear of laying down a functioning road network. Just when I think I've got a handle on ferrying each city's busy commuters between their homes and giant industrial centres, something inevitably goes wrong. The pins stack up, jams back up for miles, and gridlock eventually brings the whole city to a crashing halt. But by golly is it fun.

notes.title: Countdown to launch! Only 6 days remain...
notes.notes:
The day is drawing ever closer and we are working our tails off (spiky stegosaurus or big clubby akylosaurus, your choice) to line everything up for launch! Early content creator keys have gone out, the build is wrapped up tight with a nice little bow for Valve, and we are so excited to finally share the product of the last 18 months of hard work with you all. 

We are so thrilled to share that the lovely KatherineOfSky has put together an awesome introductory video to the Steam edition of the game. She's also got some excellent beginner tips for new players, or if you're an existing player, you can preview some of our new features below!

[previewyoutube=FRxVLzg9VM0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Answers to some common questions...[/h3]
We've put together a pre-launch FAQ over on the forums, but we wanted to share a few of the more common requests below to ensure everyone who's asked can get the answers they need!

[b]What time will the game be launching?[/b]
8:00am Pacific time on the 20th of July! (Sorry, fellow New Zealanders, that's 2am for us...)

[b]How often do you plan to offer updates?[/b]
Good news, we're already working on our next one! We roll out new maps every few months, same as we have with Mini Metro over the years. We also have additional game modes planned. We hope to eventually offer the same breadth of game modes that Mini Metro has (something for the creative/endless mode players and an extreme mode), although they may be slightly different as we'll have to tweak things for performance reasons.

[b]I'm a content creator, can I get a key?[/b]
Sure thing! The lovely Lena at Stride PR is handling key distribution for us. 
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScuxHOoHETQdkYIelWRciha2H-SHqZuwnmRP2izLbGQTgDQ1g/viewform]You can fill out their form here.[/url]

[b]Do you have a policy about whether or not content creators can monetise our videos?[/b]
We have a catch-all license on our site, but the tl;dr of it is that anyone can make Mini Motorways videos and monetise them. We don't require people to individually email for permission and we definitely don't police which regions people stream from. That sounds like a lot of work and also not particularly friendly! [url=https://dinopoloclub.com/press/mini-motorways/]You can read the policy on our press kit page here.[/url]

The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1127500/discussions/0/3049483938193654308]extended version of the FAQ[/url] has a lot more answers within!

[h3]You said there's a way to win a copy?![/h3]
We'll be giving away some copies of the game, some Steam gift cards, and a biiiig prize leading up to launch week. Details over on our [url=https://twitter.com/dinopoloclub]Twitter feed[/url]. If you're planning to attend PAX online, we'll also be hosting some giveaways there! 

[url=https://www.shacknews.com/article/125592/how-to-watch-pax-online-2021]Shacknews[/url] has a great breakdown of how to watch what when it comes to PAX. Our panel, [b]Imagining Better Worlds Through Games[/b] will air on Sunday, July 18th, from 6.30-7.30 PM EST. We'll also be hopping in and out of the [url=https://online.paxsite.com/en-us/discord.html]PAX Online Discord[/url] so if you're around, come say hi! We miss seeing everyone face to face, but until the world settles down, this is the next best thing.

We have been overwhelmed by the response and interest to the game in the week leading up to launch--we hope you'll like it as much as we love working on it! SEE YOU SOON!!

notes.title: All roads lead to Mini Motorways: what you can expect in the next few weeks!
notes.notes:
[h2]What is Mini Motorways again?[/h2]

Mini Motorways, like its spiritual-if-not-exact prequel Mini Metro, is a minimalist strategy sim about diverting and managing traffic to meet the demands of a growing city. Players will be working against time, congestion, geography, and the city's own growth while they attempt to manage the road network and keep the city moving.

[h2]After the public transport-minded Mini Metro, why make a game about cars?[/h2]

While anyone who interacts with any of us couldn’t possibly deny that we are, shall we say, train enthusiasts, we thought there was interesting ground to explore in the concept of a highway game. (Or, as we call them in New Zealand and some other parts of the world - motorways!)

Highways, at least in most cities that aren’t very new, tend to have interesting spatial challenges both from a geographic and an urban standpoint. Most motorway systems were developed long after the cities that host them were already built, so road planners are working not only against the geographical constraints that we represented in Mini Metro (hills, coastlines) but also against the city’s own pre-existing blueprint. 

While the minimalist art style of Mini Motorways doesn’t go so far as to label things “heritage district” or “historical landmark” or “giant skyscraper that is Extremely In The Way,” the challenges of building placement in this game are meant to emulate those real life issues that city planners have to work around.

[h2]This sounds kind of neat! I wanna learn more![/h2]

Our programmer and designer Tana Tanoi gave a fantastic talk at GCAP Melbourne last year where he goes into the theory and practice of attempting to create a “spiritual successor” to Mini Metro that wasn’t just the same ol’ same ol’ but with cars. You can watch it here.

[previewyoutube=crxKvSC9cDg;full][/previewyoutube]

We also go into the game's design philosophy in [url=https://www.podchaser.com/podcasts/controller-disconnected-984579/episodes/loveindies-mini-motorways-buil-63059649]this episode of the Controller Disconnected podcast[/url] for #LoveIndies week. While the pandemic has interrupted #LoveIndies for 2021, we still put some material together and will be sharing it both here and on our social media pages. 

[h2]That’s great and all but I just really wanna know what’s coming in the game![/h2]

And that’s totally fair, too! We appreciate that people have been waiting to find out what’s in the box, so to speak, and we’re happy to give a breakdown of what you can look forward to on launch:
[list]
[*] 11 stylized maps representing real cities from all over the world
[*] Multiple colour palettes per map including night and colourblind modes
[*] Five road/intersection upgrades to choose between, each offering different strategies to divert, control, and otherwise manage traffic in your city
[*] Daily and weekly challenges 
[*] Achievements both sensible and not (see if you can get Mom’s Spaghetti)
[*] A gorgeous procedurally-generated soundtrack by Disasterpiece, who also engineered Mini Metro’s audio. Each map features its own audioscape, including some easter eggs for local flavour
[*] Photo mode and GIF export so you can show off your cities to your friends
[/list]
Since launching on Apple Arcade, we’ve maintained a steady stream of content updates and will continue to do so on Steam as well. There are new maps on the horizon as well as different game modes for those who want to play the game primarily to chill out and vibe as well as people who enjoy more competitive play and making their friends beg for mercy on the leaderboards. 

We also really appreciate the folks on here who reached out to offer alpha and beta testing - for those who don’t mind a bit of jank under the hood of their Motorways experience, we will keep the testing program open for future patches and content updates, so if you didn’t get a tester key, you haven’t lost your chance. :) We try to keep our testing groups small to ensure individual feedback gets listened to, but as folks move on, go back to school, have kids, or can finally go outside again, we anticipate we’ll always need fresh folks to help test. 

[h2]I'm a streamer/curator and I'd like a key, too![/h2]

We can definitely do that! We're working with the lovely Lena at Stride to handle key distribution so that we can cover more than just the New Zealand time zone. If you fill out our press/media inquiry form, we'll get your details to her and she can sort you out with a key. 

Thanks so much for your interest! [url=https://forms.gle/74S6VBs431Z6QzkV9]You can find the form here.[/url]

[h2]Upcoming Events[/h2]

As one last bit of news, we'll be at PAX East Online this year! Tana will be joining our Community Lead Casey Lucas-Quaid and a selection of other devs, streamers, and a science fiction author to [b]Imagine Better Worlds Through Games[/b], where we look at how games and science fiction can help us conquer engineering problems of the present. [url=https://online.paxsite.com/]We'll see you there from 15th to 18th July, and you can view programme information here![/url]

Since that's just before our launch weekend - and what is a PAX without swag? - there will be opportunities to win Steam gift cards, keys for both Mini Motorways and Mini Metro, and more! We'll be posting about all that here beforehand so you won't miss your chance. :)

Thanks for reading and see you soon!

notes.title: Time to hit the road! Mini Motorways will be releasing on July 20th, 2021
notes.notes:
Beep beep! You may have noticed the new announcement trailer on our store page. We’re excited to share that Mini Motorways will be making its Steam debut on July 20th, 2021.

We’ve been excited to bring Mini Motorways to our Steam audience since day one and loved the support you’ve given us with Mini Metro, especially when we released the Steam Workshop update. We would like to reward your patience and your enthusiasm by making sure the new features and maps are as polished as possible before cementing them in place.

May proved to be just a little too soon for all the new content we have planned for this update, and the new features and improved performance under the hood are how we know it’ll be worth the wait. We want to get this version of the game in your hands as soon as possible and we are very grateful for how patient everyone has been.

Something we’re super thrilled about is that we’ve grown our team of dinos and we have some more folks who will be helping us keep in touch with our wonderful players! This means that we’ve now got the ability to run a dev blog on Steam, which we’ll be updating regularly, showing off in-progress features and maps for both our Steam release and beyond. Like Mini Metro before it, we will be supporting Mini Motorways for a long time, rolling out new game modes, challenges, and achievements.
 
So what can you expect moving forward? There’s a lot more that we’re excited to share with you, both for the initial release and everything that comes after! We’ll be debuting a new trailer, setting up some stickied posts on the forums, and checking in nice and regularly around these parts :)

Thanks again for your support and your excitement!

notes.title: Mini Motorways tosses Mini Metro's trains to take on traffic management
notes.notes:
Mini Metro is awfully pleasant, isn’t it? I’ve grown quite fond of lounging around, putting together an idealised transit system that – no matter how much I fudge things up – always turns out utopian compared to what the real world can put together. Yes, I say to myself, isn’t it lovely to lay down this tramline without racking up millions of quid and shutting down half the city. Truly, games are fantastical creations.

Now that developers Dinosaur Polo Club have solved railway problems for good (probably), their next shot is aimed squarely at the bad boy of public infrastructure. Announced today, Mini Motorways will take on traffic.

(more…)
